evidence.observation: Four silicone bags in green, yellow, pink, and clear are filled with leaves, lemons, broccoli, carrots, and tomatoes; Japanese text introduces the product.
A clear silicone bag holds strawberries and lemon slices; a hand holds the bottom of the open bag.
Hands place kiwi, mango cubes, and berries into a clear bag; Japanese text explains putting food in and sliding to close.
The sealed bag with fruit sits on a refrigerator shelf among other containers.
A hand holds a sealed bag containing a layered sandwich in front of an open microwave; Japanese text states microwave compatibility up to 230°C.
The bag with the sandwich is placed on the microwave turntable.
Four bags with different colored seals sit on a kitchen counter; Japanese text lists sizes 500ml to 3000ml.
A close-up shows a green bag containing a basil plant with leaves growing out of the top.
Four bags are labeled Small, Medium, Large, and Extra Large with green Japanese text overlay urging viewers to check now.
The same four bags appear empty/clear with the same green text overlay remaining on screen.
Product box displays the RONGTA printer image and feature list; overlay text describes Wireless Bluetooth, Battery-Powered, Compatible with 8.5" x 11" US Letter Paper.
A blank white sheet of thermal paper is held up; a box labeled "Thermal Paper Thermopapier" is visible at the top edge.
Packaged thermal paper in plastic wrap sits in front of a box labeled "US Letter" and "Thermal Paper Thermopapier".
Close-up of the grey printer body edge against a carpet background; no paper is visible in this frame.
The printer is shown with a green "Standby" indicator light illuminated; white paper is being fed into the printer slot.
A hand holds white paper that has exited the printer; the paper appears blank with no visible printed text, labels, or output.
Hands hold a clear silicone bag over a baking dish with casserole. Text overlay reads 'Stop wasting money on Aluminum Foil'.
Hands lift a sheet of aluminum foil off the same baking dish. Text overlay reads 'You are doing all wrong'.
Hands place the clear silicone bag over the baking dish containing the food.
The baking dish is fully covered by the clear silicone bag. Text overlay reads 'Eco-friendly'.
The clear bag is held up near the edge of the black baking dish. Text overlay reads 'Oven Safe (Up to 425F)'.
The baking dish is covered with the clear bag again. Text overlay reads 'And freezer safe'.
